messages:
nina_sales: heads-up ACME wants sustained 2k RPS + short bursts to 10k RPS (avg prompt ~30 tokens). They prefer small reserved commit + predictable burst credits. looping @omar_se @rachel_ml @chris_infra for sizing and prewarm approach.

omar_se: ok. need two plans: steady 2k RPS p99 <200ms, and burst to 10k. which model? base or large? base -> fewer GPUs.

acme_poc_pm: POC uses redwood-3-base; optional large upgrade later. cost sensitive. prefer fewer reserved GPUs + managed burst.

rachel_ml: rough: 1 H100 ~=800-1k RPS on short prompts. Plan A (conservative): 4 reserved H100 -> autoscale to 8 for bursts. Plan B (lean): 2 reserved H100 + burst credits + warm pool; accepts occasional p99 blips. Also recommend adaptive batching (max_batch_size=64) and prefix/KV cache notes.

chris_infra: prewarm + KV cache warm ~45-90s. suggest warm pool + prewarm trigger. recommend reserved spread across 2 AZs for resilience. sample autoscale snippet for appendix provided.

omar_se: I'll produce monthly cost estimates for both plans and burst-credit pricing.

nina_sales: action items: Omar & Rachel draft capacity appendix and cost delta; Chris to document prewarm, AZ affinity, spot-routing for non-PII; I'll collate security questions and ask about Private deployment. Aim: draft by EOD tomorrow.

acme_poc_pm: thanks, meeting tomorrow 10:30 PT. security lead will join.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: 2024-06-05T17:30Z for POC config push.
